description_expanded: Searching for a cheerful vacation home that has views of a pristine Coastal Dune Lake as well as the gorgeous jewel toned Gulf of Mexico? You can have it all in this delightful setting right on Scenic 30A in Dune Allen Beach. Laffy Taffy is a modern three bedroom home with two full baths, two half baths, and three stories of Old Florida nostalgic charm. The white picket fence, palm trees and white columned front porch bid you a gracious welcome while the bright white exteriors create a coastal setting. This Dune Allen Beach vacation home overlooks the glistening gulf towards the south and Oyster Lake to the north so can enjoy the best of both worlds. The location places you directly across the street from the beach walkover so you are a less than a minute to the white sand shore and are ready to luxuriate in the emerald Gulf waters. The interiors of Laffy Taffy are both cozy and comfortable with a plush long couch that has an abundance of pillows and accent chairs in the main living area. A charming white table with four oval backed decorative chairs and a bench sits nearby to serve as the dining room. The bright creamy white kitchen has an open breakfast bar with four additional seats for the enjoyment of tasty seafood appetizers. A porch outside has additional seating where you may feel the rich salty breeze and hear the soothing sound of the surf when the waves are high. Three nicely decorated bedrooms are upstairs and the spacious Primary Suite with a king sized bed has a nice balcony facing the glistening gulf as well as a private bathroom. The other Guest Bedrooms have balconies that look out upon the lovely lake. Upstairs on the third floor is a "Bonus Room" which serves as a nice den, has a rooftop Observation Deck where you may enjoy the special scenery. There is also a Queen Sleeper Sofa and Powder Room on this floor, ideal for visiting guest. Besides having the beach close by, the Beach Haven Cottages neighborhood has a private lakeside community pool which is just a short stroll away. This Dune Allen Beach locale is on Scenic 30A so you are not far from the picturesque beach towns that parallel the forested coast. Galleries, seasonal festivals, unique boutiques, restaurants and lively bars are not far away. You are also close to Miramar Beach for world class shopping at Silver Sands , the nation's largest Designer Discount Outlet, as well as family fare at the fun Disneyesque version of the New Orleans French Quarter known as The Village of Baytowne Wharf in Sandestin . First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, Powder Room. Second Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Balcony Access, Queen Bedroom with Balcony Access,  Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower,  Bedroom with Two Twin Beds and Balcony Access, Laundry. Third Floor: Bonus Loft with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Powder Room + Balcony Access.
